subject: RFP: Private/VPC Deployment - Isolation and Data Flow Questions
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@silverline-retail.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
Cc: Silverline Security Team <security@silverline-retail.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Private/VPC Deployment - Isolation and Data Flow Questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking our RFP. Attached is the questionnaire we use for evaluating private/VPC and air-gapped deployments (RFP_Silverline_PrivateDeploy_Questions.xlsx). We have a few priority items we need clear answers on for our procurement and security review:

- Network isolation model (required diagrams and firewall rule examples)
- How data flows between customer services and Redwood control plane in the Private offering
- Process for offline/air-gapped model updates and cryptographic verification of artifacts
- KMS/HSM integration options and key custody models
- Patch cadence and approved maintenance windows for on-prem instances
- Evidence: SOC 2 point-in-time report, recent penetration test summary, and any FedRAMP mappings if available

Our timeline: security and procurement will assemble final recommendations by Oct 12, so if possible please provide a consolidated response + diagrams by Oct 6. We may request a short technical call after your response.

Attachments: RFP_Silverline_PrivateDeploy_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Director, Infrastructure Security
Silverline Retail

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita.rao@silverline-retail.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Private/VPC Deployment - Isolation and Data Flow Questions

Laura / Rishi — looping you both in. Anita sent Silverline's RFP spreadsheet with focused questions on isolation, offline updates, and evidence. Anita asked for a consolidated answer + diagrams by Oct 6.

Proposed split:
- Laura: network isolation diagrams + firewall rule examples, packaging of redwood_private_deploy_diagram.pdf and network_firewall_rules.xlsx.
- Rishi: technical write-up for air-gapped/offline model update procedure, HSM/KMS integration options, patch cadence, and required evidence artifacts.

Key points to cover in responses (please put short bullets and a one-page recommended implementation):
1) VPC-only mode vs air-gapped on-prem: describe the difference in control-plane dependence and what network egress is required in each case.
2) Data-in-flight and at-rest encryption: describe TLS, mutual auth, and disk-level encryption (LUKS/VM-level encryption) and where keys are held.
3) Air-gapped model updates: step-by-step flow (artifact signing, verification checksums, delivery mechanism, operator steps).
4) KMS/HSM options: external KMS (customer-managed AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault), on-prem HSM integration (PKCS#11), bring-your-own-key (BYOK) limitations.
5) Patching & maintenance: recommended patch cadence, emergency patch process, and how patch windows are coordinated with customer.
6) Evidence & compliance: which artifacts we can deliver (SOC 2 report PDF excerpt, penetration test summary, config hardening checklist), and any redactions required.

Laura: can you draft the diagrams and firewall rule examples and attach them to the reply? Rishi: please prepare the air-gap procedure with verification hashes and include a sample manifest format. I'll do a quick pass before we send.

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@silverline-retail.com>

Date: 2026-10-02T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Private/VPC Deployment - Isolation and Data Flow Questions

Vivek / team —

A couple of clarifications while you assemble the materials:

1) For air-gapped installs, do you support an on-site Redwood engineer to perform the first upgrade, or do customers perform the process themselves with your runbooks? If you support on-site, please list typical SOW duration and rates.
2) For artifact delivery into air-gapped environments: can you sign artifacts with an organizational signing key and provide the public verification key? Does your manifest include SHA256 checksums for every binary and model shard?
3) Do you provide automated integrity checks during service startup that fail safe on mismatch?
4) Regarding HSM: can customer HSMs be used to protect both transport-layer certificates and disk encryption keys, or only one of the above?

Also, procurement asked whether Redwood is willing to execute a limited SLA addendum for an air-gapped deployment (example: 99.5% uptime for dedicated on-prem pool) and requested any precedent (redactions OK).

If you can answer the 4 clarifications and include any sample language for SLA addendum, that will help move us forward.

Regards,
Anita

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@silverline-retail.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-10-05T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Private/VPC Deployment - Isolation and Data Flow Questions

Anita — thanks for the clarifying questions. See consolidated responses and attached artifacts. I've kept the answers concise and included attachments: redwood_private_deploy_diagram.pdf (network isolation diagram), network_firewall_rules.xlsx (sample rules), and a draft SLA addendum (signed_sla_addendum.pdf) as a template we have used with other customers (redacted).

Short answers to your numbered clarifications:

1) On-site support for first upgrade: Yes. We offer an on-site deployment/upgrade option. Typical SOW: 2–5 business days depending on cluster size, with options for remote oversight. Rates vary by region — we will provide a scoped SOW once we confirm cluster specs. If Silverline prefers customer-executed upgrades, we provide detailed runbooks and a gap checklist and offer a 2-hour remote verification call as part of standard support.

2) Artifact signing & manifests: All release artifacts for air-gapped delivery are signed by Redwood's release signing key (RSA-4096) and distributed with a manifest that contains SHA256 checksums for every binary, model shard, and container image reference. Customers receive the corresponding public signing key and a verification script. See sample manifest excerpt in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_example_shared_answers

3) Automated integrity checks: Yes. Our on-prem agent performs startup integrity verification (checksums + signature verification) for every installed artifact. If verification fails, services will not start and we expose clear failure codes and an audit log entry for forensic review. We can optionally configure a 'quarantine-only' mode for nonblocking alerts during validation windows.

4) HSM integration: Customer HSMs (PKCS#11 compatible) can be used for both transport TLS private keys and disk encryption key wrapping. Our recommended model is to store a master wrapping key in the HSM and rotate wrapped keys per-host. For cloud KMS integrations, we support AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault (BYOK) for control-plane secrets; on-prem HSMs are recommended for full key custody in air-gapped environments.

Additional implementation notes:
- Network flow: In VPC-private mode, a minimal outbound control-plane channel (mutual TLS) is used for metrics and license heartbeat; in fully air-gapped installs this channel is disabled and all telemetry is stored locally with an optional secure courier process for logs.
- Patching cadence: standard quarterly security patch bundle with opt-in accelerated security patches for critical CVEs (48–72 hour window for critical fixes). Emergency patches are coordinated via our incident process and can be applied by the on-site engineer or trained customer operator.
- Evidence: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and a pen-test summary under NDA. We have templates for configuration hardening that we will include in the Drive folder.

Next steps / deliverables we are attaching:
- redwood_private_deploy_diagram.pdf (network isolation and data flow)
- network_firewall_rules.xlsx (sample firewall/external ACLs)
- signed_sla_addendum.pdf (example addendum language)
- sample manifest & verification script (Drive link)

If you want, we can set a 30-minute technical deep-dive next week to walk through the diagram and manifest verification with your security architects. Please let us know availability.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Architect, Security & Private Deploy
Redwood Inference
